# Sources registry

Writer-safe claim registry DERIVED from Research Agent evidence (Doc 0 is source truth — this is
never a second research database, and never open-web verification: that is the finished-script
fact-check, D-SFC-1). Refute-first, fresh model family (judge family, never the drafter's).
Mechanical columns (#, claim, source, status seed) come from RA output; judgment columns (class,
LB, wordings, anchor) come from the fresh-eyes pass. No CONFIRMED without a named, verifiable
source. The drafter voices only a row's anchor (D-21); no anchor = the number goes bare.

Classes: STORY (what a source says, told as them saying it) · THEORY (interpretive) · REALITY
(safe in our voice). Status: CONFIRMED / REPORTED / CONTESTED / MISSING-SOURCE.

| # | claim | class | status | source | LB | allowed wording | prohibited wording | anchor |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 |  | STORY/THEORY/REALITY |  | SRC_n / fact id |  y/n |  |  | — |

MISSING SOURCE = attribute and keep, never cut. A negative strikes the specific, never the event.
